body:
As banking apps go this continues to be one of the poor ones.
Good points - facial recognition to login, easy to see your main account balance, templates for transfers to other accounts in UAE and other countries (can be saved), online payment of credit cards.
Bad points - extremely muddled and in fact incorrect presentation of credit cards and supplementary cards and their transactions, continues to show some (but not all) blocked and expired cards even after the user designating favourites or cards being replaced. Even the supplementary card shows before my own cards! Most of the time the app mixes the transactions of different cards under the wrong card. I end up relying on the text messages, PDF or printed statements because the app is so poor.
Despite raising the shortcomings on several versions ago it is still an issue today!
